question: When f(m) = m⁵ + 5m⁴ - 3m + 7 is divided by (m - 2), then the remainder is _____.
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ By the Remainder Theorem, the remainder when f(m) is divided by (m − 2) is simply f(2). Substitute m = 2 into the given polynomial directly: f(2) = 2⁵ + 5(2)⁴ − 3(2) + 7 f(2) = 32 + 80 − 6 + 7 = 113 **∴ The correct answer is 113.**
